name: J02 elicitation probe - what happens when a server asks the client a question
about: AN OBSERVATION, NOT AN ASSERTION OF SUCCESS.
The frozen oracle answers MCP elicitation and raises a form
reconstruction has McpElicitationId and FormOwner::Global in its types and
NO elicitation handling anywhere in grapt-mcp or the dogfood surface.
Reading `decode_reply` predicts a CorrelationMismatch: it requires the next
frame to carry the id of the request in flight, and a server-initiated
`elicitation/create` carries its own. A prediction is not a measurement, and
mine have been wrong three times this campaign, so this scenario exists to
It therefore asserts only what must be true either way: the ask appears and
is approved. Everything after that is captured and read from the durable
record and the server transcript, so the run reports what the product did
instead of failing on an expectation I invented.

steps.paste: Call the journey_echo tool with the text daily-use and then report, character for character, the exact text the tool returned.
